name: Server Meshing
description:
Splits a map across several map-server processes ("cells") with seamless handoff, ghosting across cell edges, seams between maps, cells of any size, on-demand ("sleeping") cells, and dynamic cells the central cuts and merges at runtime, by command or by its own load policy.
Dynamic cells are supervised (a dead or hung cell is restarted, a cell cut off from the cluster fences itself), buildings follow the cut, and a restarted central adopts the cut layout and resumes the operation it was running.
Players cross a cell edge without a loading screen; neighbouring cells exchange ghosts of everything near their shared edge, so combat, loot, quests and building resolve across it. Empty land costs nothing: a cell with nobody near it does not run.
Subclasses on the kit's managers and entity prefabs plus one world-registry asset; the package changes no kit file. Needs OpenMMORPG develop at d077c5f (2026-10-20) or later: the add-on does not compile on an older kit (see the README). Includes a Setup window that validates a project, judges every Dynamic map's cut and settings before anything starts, and fixes what it can.
